description:
Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown
Project: E-Waste Collection Drive
Location: Antop Hill Warehousing
Collection: 79 kg of E-Waste

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown organised an E-Waste Collection Drive at Antop Hill Warehousing, successfully collecting 79 kg of electronic waste.

The initiative promotes responsible disposal and recycling of discarded electronic items, preventing hazardous materials from contaminating our soil and water. It also helps recover valuable materials, reduces pressure on natural resources and minimises waste going into landfills.

Every kilogram of e-waste collected is a step towards a cleaner, safer and more sustainable environment.

Small actions today can create a greener tomorrow!
